g.text: 48 ft × 9 ft canvas · three 16:9 tiles · one media PC
Panel ① is the brain. Only the Agent panel drives state; ② and ③ mirror it from a broadcast
snapshot, so they can never disagree with what the audience just did.
⚠ Sync needs ONE shared HTTPS origin. On file:// paths each window is a separate opaque
origin and the panels silently stop syncing. Always launch from the hosted URL.
